cards.name: Sleight of Mind
cards.oracleText: Change the text of target spell or permanent by replacing all instances of one color word with another. (For example, you may change "target black spell" to "target blue spell." This effect lasts indefinitely.)

cards.name: Sleight of Hand
cards.oracleText: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other on the bottom of your library.
